body:
Current IGN: Droxus
Accs I hacked on: I've hacked on around 3 accs
Reason for being banned: Hacking on the server. Then alting while being banned on other accs.
Reason to unban:
I've stopped hacking. The only reason I hacked because it seemed fun at first, and I also told myself I'd only hack for a bit of time and then i'd stop, which I did. I have now stopped hacking and its been 5 months since the last time I hacked. I hope I can get unbanned.
